full_judgment: 29. In the case of Azad Publication Ltd. and others vs. Md. Qamrul Anam Khan 1981 BLD (AD) 426 after a detailed discussion of the relevant Articles of the Articles of Association of the company, regulation 112 as well as section 27 of the General Clauses Act it was held that where notice is served by post the presumption of service of such notice will be raised if the notice was sent by registered post. The company court Judge has relied on this judgment and has come to the conclusion that notice regarding transfer of shares was not served on the shareholders.
